subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this narrow run/harness/context bucket policy, or the broader Prometheus-aligned duration policy from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098?
rationale: Both open PRs use the supported OTel advice mechanism, but they change existing exported metric defaults with different scope and bucket ranges, which automation cannot choose as a product policy.

options.title: Choose one policy first
options.body: Select the narrow or broader bucket policy, then require real OTel export proof on the selected branch before merge.

options.title: Accept this narrow scope
options.body: Merge this PR only if maintainers deliberately want one-hour run/harness buckets plus context-token buckets while leaving other millisecond histograms on defaults.

options.title: Pause both PRs
options.body: Hold both branches if exported metric bucket defaults need a diagnostics owner decision before any aggregation layout changes ship.

recommendation.title: Choose one policy first
recommendation.body: Select the narrow or broader bucket policy, then require real OTel export proof on the selected branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest history match for current diagnostics-otel histogram creation and OTel migration work.
